messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

To reduce the risk of cardiovascular events in adults with:
Multiple risk factors for coronary heart disease (CHD), but without established CHD.
Use: to reduce the risk of myocardial infarction (MI), stroke, revascularization procedures, and angina.
Type 2 diabetes and multiple risk factors for CHD, without established CHD Use: to help reduce the risk of MI and stroke.
Adults with clinically evident CHD should use this to reduce the risk of non-fatal MI.
It is used to reduce the risk of fatal and non-fatal stroke.
It is used to reduce the risk of revascularization procedures.
It is used to reduce the risk of hospitalization for congestive heart failure.
It is used to reduce the risk of angina.
As an adjunct to diet to lower LDL-C:
Adults with primary hyperlipidemia.
Adults and pediatric patients (10 years and older) with heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HeFH).
As an adjunct to other LDL-lowering therapies:
For adults and pediatric patients (10 years and older) with homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia.
Triplet: ["Atorvastatin", "used as adjunct to diet to lower", "LDL-C in adults with primary hyperlipidemia"]

The relation 'used as adjunct to diet to lower' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is used in combination with dietary changes to lower the specified biochemical or medical parameter.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'lowers level of': The subject drug decreases the level of the substance or biomarker specified by the object entity in the body.
B. 'has dose adjustment instruction': The subject drug may require changes in dosage based on the condition or factor specified in the object entity.
C. 'may be prescribed with': The subject drug may be prescribed in combination with the medication specified by the object entity.
D. 'reduces risk of': The subject drug is used to prevent or lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'used after': The subject drug is used following the treatment or condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
